Package arztis.econnector.ihe.queries

Class PharmTransactions

java.lang.Object
arztis.econnector.ihe.queries.PharmTransactions
public class PharmTransactions
extends java.lang.Object
This class includes all needed transactions of IHE CMPD (Community Medication Prescription and Dispense) integration profile. This profile describes the process of planning, prescribing, validating, dispensing and administering drugs in a domain.
This profile includes PHARM-1 transaction to query pharmacy documents. Furthermore this profile also contains transactions of IHE XDS profile. This XDS transactions are available in XdsTransactions. XDS transactions are needed to retrieve document set (ITI-43) and to provide and register documents (ITI-41)
This class contains PHARM-1 transaction. This transaction provides some specilalized requests to find certain kind of document for specific purposes like for prescription.
  • FindMedicationTreatmentPlans
  • FindPrescriptions
  • FindDispenses
  • FindMedicationAdministrations
  • FindPrescriptionsForValidation
  • FindPrescriptionsForDispense
In ELGA reference client, requests for finding prescriptions, for finding prescriptions for dispense, finding medication treatment plans and for finding medication administrations have been implemented.

Anna Jungwirth

  • Method Details

    • findMedicationList

      public RegistryObjectListType findMedicationList​(org.ehealth_connector.common.Identificator patientId, org.ehealth_connector.common.at.enums.AvailabilityStatus status, AssertionType assertion, java.lang.String typeCode) throws org.apache.xmlbeans.XmlException, java.rmi.RemoteException
      This method queries medication treatment plan for a given patient. In ELGA, this method can be used to query medication list or complete immunization status.
      Parameters:
      patientId - ID of patient to be queried
      status - restricts set of returned entries according to the availability status
      assertion - assertion that authenticate health care provider who requests medciation treatment plan.
      typeCode - indicates whether medication list or complete immunization status should be queried. Values are available under https://termpub.gesundheit.gv.at:443/TermBrowser/gui/main/main.zul?loadType=ValueSet&loadName=HL7-at_XDS-Dokumentenklassen
      Returns:
      if request was successful medication treatment plan is returned as RegistryObjectListType
      Throws:
      org.apache.xmlbeans.XmlException - the xml exception
      java.rmi.RemoteException - the remote exception

    • findPrescriptionsForDispenses

      public AdhocQueryResponseDocument findPrescriptionsForDispenses​(org.ehealth_connector.common.Identificator patientId, org.ehealth_connector.common.at.enums.AvailabilityStatus status, AssertionType samlTicket, boolean forDispenses) throws java.rmi.RemoteException, org.apache.xmlbeans.XmlException
      This method queries all prescription documents for a given patient or only those that are ready for dispensing. In ELGA, this method can be used to query prescriptions.
      Parameters:
      patientId - ID of patient to be queried
      status - restricts set of returned entries according to the availability status
      samlTicket - assertion that authenticate health care provider who requests prescriptions.
      forDispenses - indicates whether all prescriptions or only prescriptions for dispenses should be queried.
      Returns:
      if request was successful metadata of found prescriptions are returned as AdhocQueryResponseDocument
      Throws:
      java.rmi.RemoteException
      org.apache.xmlbeans.XmlException

    • findMedicationAdministrations

      public AdhocQueryResponseDocument findMedicationAdministrations​(org.ehealth_connector.common.Identificator patientId, org.ehealth_connector.common.at.enums.AvailabilityStatus status, AssertionType samlTicket, java.lang.String authorInstitutionId) throws java.rmi.RemoteException, org.apache.xmlbeans.XmlException
      This method queries medication administration documents for a given patient. In ELGA, this method can be used to query self-created immunization notes.
      Parameters:
      patientId - ID of patient to be queried
      status - restricts set of returned entries according to the availability status
      samlTicket - assertion that authenticate health care provider who requests prescriptions.
      authorInstitutionId - restricts set of returned entries according to the given OID of author
      Returns:
      if request was successful metadata of found medication administration documents are returned as AdhocQueryResponseDocument
      Throws:
      java.rmi.RemoteException - the remote exception
      org.apache.xmlbeans.XmlException - the xml exception
